CustomField.description: SLA compliance outcome for this routing attempt. Met = assignment completed within SLA_Minutes__c target. Breached = assignment exceeded target. Blank/null = SLA_Minutes__c not configured on the routing config, or routing did not result in a successful assignment. Picklist instead of Checkbox because SF Checkboxes cannot be null — we need three states for accurate analytics (Met vs Breached vs Not Tracked).
CustomField.label: SLA Met
